overallReason: OPTED and Illusion of Depth pass. MILER contains one localized factual error in its Figure 7 interpretation and must be corrected before the final review.

blockingFindings.currentText: 天气、光照与车辆设置共同变化，不能仅凭该图判定单一原因。
blockingFindings.problem: Figure 7 compares the second and third laps of the same vehicle B. The paper explicitly attributes the BEV appearance difference to darker conditions and rainfall; it does not report a vehicle-setup change between these two laps.
blockingFindings.primaryEvidence: Fixed v1 PDF Figure 7 caption / text lines 593–598 and deployment text lines 549–553.
blockingFindings.requiredRewrite: 天气与光照同时变化；原文只明确较暗条件和降雨强烈影响 BEV，不能仅凭该图分离二者的贡献。

nonBlockingCorrections.problem: ‘训练只采用车辆 A 的自行车模型参数’ is broader than the paper. The paper states that wheelbase is the only vehicle-specific training parameter and that training uses vehicle A's 2.60 m wheelbase.
nonBlockingCorrections.suggestedRewrite: 训练时采用车辆 A 的 2.60 m 轴距；论文将轴距列为自行车模型中唯一的车辆特定训练参数。

accessLimitations: No official MILER method repository, complete generated maps/real-drive data release, executable configuration, policy weights, or modified BEVFusion weights were verified.
The linked evaluation video was not watched; no claim relies on it.
No simulation, policy training, or real-vehicle test was run.

figures.visualFinding: Opened production PNG. The upper deployment stream is camera/LiDAR to BEVFusion to the shared RL policy and trajectory alignment; the lower training stream is the MLR simulator/bicycle model. This supports the report's modular-interface caveat.

Opened production PNG. The same vehicle B passes the narrow gap on lap two (left) and sees a narrower drivable corridor/stops on lap three (right). The visual and original caption support darkness/rain effects, not a changed vehicle setup.

reports.claimVerdict: PASS: threat assumptions, stereo geometry, sampling/calibration mechanism, KITTI synthesis scale, maximum-disparity table semantics, SGM-DDC limitations, 10/15 km/h physical durations, 40 km/h CARLA-only scope, and defense thresholds/denominators match the fixed v1 body.
